github_commits_by_members: Commits by group members per month

Source: R/github_commits_by_members.R
github_commits_by_members.Rd

The number of commits that group members made per month, and how many of them carry an agent trailer. Counted as in github_commits (no bots, no automated pushes, no merge commits), with two differences: commits by people outside the group are left out, and so are commits in the training organisations (workshop exercises). Who is a group member comes from a lookup that is not part of the package. The lookup is complete for the last 24 months; in the months before, everyone counts as a group member except the people the lookup names as outside the group.

Usage

github_commits_by_members

Format

A tibble with 4 variables

month

First day of the month.

commits

Commits by group members in the month, without commits in the training organisations.

commits_assisted

Number of these commits that carry an agent trailer.

lookup_complete

TRUE for the months in which every person was checked against the lookup of group members.

Source

GitHub REST API, read with data-raw/data_processing_github_people.R.
